evidence.semanticReview: The outboard shaft/propeller/mount assembly has a functional topology absent from the existing automotive engine-block glyph; it is not a ship style variant.
evidence.sourceComposition: Upper motor casing connected by a bent shaft to a lower vertical gear housing and propeller.
evidence.comparison: Frozen canonical/variant/repair plus 510 motion and 3157 design source concepts, paint-independent SVG structure and D4-normalized contours. No claim of universal visual uniqueness.

existingConceptDifference.reason: The existing Phosphor Boat SVG contains a complete vessel hull, superstructure and bow. The new source has no hull: it depicts an outboard motor casing, bent drive shaft, lower gear housing and propeller. These are different functional component constructions; the shared boat token describes mounting context, not geometry equivalence.

evidence.semanticReview: The rope/wheel/hook topology is a complete lifting subassembly; the existing tower crane does not duplicate this standalone mechanism.
evidence.sourceComposition: Oval wheel housing with pivot hole, two rope leads and a hanging curved hook.
evidence.comparison: Frozen canonical/variant/repair plus 510 motion and 3157 design source concepts, paint-independent SVG structure and D4-normalized contours. No claim of universal visual uniqueness.

evidence.semanticReview: The sliding blade/frame/aperture topology is a distinct physical apparatus. A CSS card effect named guillotine is not the same depicted object.
evidence.sourceComposition: Tall two-post frame, slanted suspended blade and a circular neck aperture in the lower crossbar.
evidence.comparison: Frozen canonical/variant/repair plus 510 motion and 3157 design source concepts, paint-independent SVG structure and D4-normalized contours. No claim of universal visual uniqueness.

evidence.semanticReview: No flute/pan-pipe counterpart was found in the complete fixed shape inputs. The connected graded pipe array is a distinct wind-instrument construction, rather than a generic stripe pattern.
evidence.sourceComposition: Parallel open pipes of graded length joined by horizontal binding channels.
evidence.comparison: Frozen canonical/variant/repair plus 510 motion and 3157 design source concepts, paint-independent SVG structure and D4-normalized contours. No claim of universal visual uniqueness.

evidence.semanticReview: The actual organ body and vessel connections differ from an existing bilobed valentine heart symbol. Retain one anatomical heart; internal-organ changes the same organ vessel styling.
evidence.sourceComposition: Asymmetric rounded cardiac body with several open arterial/venous tubes emerging from its upper edge.
evidence.comparison: Frozen canonical/variant/repair plus 510 motion and 3157 design source concepts, paint-independent SVG structure and D4-normalized contours. No claim of universal visual uniqueness.

existingConceptDifference.reason: The existing Line MD heart SVG draws the symmetric bilobed pointed valentine symbol. The new source depicts an asymmetric organ body connected to several open aortic/venous tubes. A valentine silhouette with pulse decoration does not carry this anatomical vessel topology. Keep one anatomical heart source and fold internal-organ into it.

evidence.semanticReview: The separate tool/object insertion relationship forms a manipulation scene beyond a plain padlock or key glyph; retain one complete source arrangement.
evidence.sourceComposition: Two thin elongated tools cross and enter a separate rounded keyhole/cylinder-like body.
evidence.comparison: Frozen canonical/variant/repair plus 510 motion and 3157 design source concepts, paint-independent SVG structure and D4-normalized contours. No claim of universal visual uniqueness.

existingConceptDifference.reason: The existing lock SVG draws a padlock body, U-shaped shackle and central keyhole. The new source contains a separate rounded keyhole/cylinder-like target plus two thin crossing insertion tools. This is a tool/target manipulation arrangement, rather than changing the fill or shackle outline of a lock glyph.

evidence.semanticReview: The sealed port/window/flange assembly differs structurally from the existing motorcycle helmet with an open visor; it is a complete apparatus rather than added face decoration.
evidence.sourceComposition: Enclosed spherical shell with circular barred front window, two side ports and a flanged collar/base.
evidence.comparison: Frozen canonical/variant/repair plus 510 motion and 3157 design source concepts, paint-independent SVG structure and D4-normalized contours. No claim of universal visual uniqueness.
